meta.title: A vendor cannot regret a line on another vendor's draft
gaps: the plan has the buyer send POST /v1/bids/{{bidUuid}}/create_bid_products, but the buyer's web-console session may not call POST /v1/bids/:id/create_bid_products (bids#create_bid_trade_products is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
library case BID-SUBMIT-002 is written for a vendor's session, but the plan sends it as the buyer
Opening a specific draft bid for vendor 2 with lock_quote_after_submission off, and attempting a line regret as vendor 1

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Bid not found”, and never with a server error.
